newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares egde higher, seen treading water.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares egde higher, seen treading water.

text.p: Slovenian shares rose 0.2 percent on Friday, recovering their poise after recent falls and traders forecast the market would remain stable pending the formation of a new government.
* The 10-share SBI index rose 2.27 points to 1,152.2.
* Overall five shares rose, 10 fell and 10 were untraded.
* Drug producer Lek's "A" issue was the most active share, falling 0.16 percent to 18,840 tolars on volume of 113.0 million tolars.
